_note: case-actions-placed-on-the-case-page: decisionSentOn is the day the case's latest decision went out. CaseRemedy::recordSent() writes it when a decision is sent; portaliq reads it as the start of the bezwaar window on the case page (createBezwaar onCase.window.from). case 1.61.0.

decisionSentOn.title: Decision sent on
decisionSentOn.description: The day the latest decision on this case was sent. Set by dossiq when the decision goes out, not by hand.
